verdicts.item: (3) CURRENT CORE EarlyAccessProductCard fidelity, including restrictive-state CTA behaviour
verdicts.note:
Confirmed independently at de51543 (tree ea056ad). Receipt sha256 b253cd40... matches.

What passes:
- Anatomy, AVAILABILITY_COPY and ACTION_COPY strings match Core.
- Held, quote and pending render no quantity control and no action, matching EarlyAccessProductCard.tsx:184, 257, 294-311.

The defect is real. coreCardPresentation (preview.js:64-74) maps every Care row (family clinical_formulations_503a, build-founder-preview.mjs:93-101) to AVAILABILITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. founder-preview.test.mjs:569-578 locks this in.
- Receipt: GRP-0001 and GRP-0073 have actionTexts ['Request availability'] and quantityCount 1 at all 10 widths.
- Capture product-card-comparison-desktop-1440.png, Care CURRENT CORE card at y~2230-2890. It reads 'Not available for direct purchase.', then shows a research stepper, 'Featured checkout... Research Bundle, 20% savings', and a black 'Request availability' button. The card contradicts itself.
- GRP-0073 shows the same at y~7240-8600.

Why Core never renders this:
- In Core, AVAILABILITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED requires a founder release whose only remaining gap is FULFILLMENT_UNAVAILABLE (storefront-view.ts:254-257, 328-348).
- NO_FOUNDER_RELEASE yields TEMPORARILY_HELD (:332-341).
- Units never named in a release are excluded from the customer catalog (:147-163).
- 503a rows are provider-pathway by family (pathway-authority.ts:12-13, 57-62).
- Core's stepper is the research-unit selector (EarlyAccessQuantitySelector.tsx:156, 209).

One correction to the residual:
- Core's actual Care card treatment is in AssistedOrderPage.tsx:232-244. It shows the notice 'This product requires provider review through Xenios Care and cannot be added to a research order request' and a PRIMARY green .xenios-order-button 'Continue through Care' (action-policy.ts:55-61) linking to /care. It has no quantity control.
- This is visible in the actual Core capture core-synthetic-catalog-order-request-cards-desktop-1440.png, 'Synthetic Care Item' card at roughly x548-1060, y1434-1890.
- The btn-secondary 'Continue through Xenios Care' cited in the residual belongs to OrderEntryIntentNotice, not the card.

Scope:
- The decisions-page D pair uses Research GRP-0256 (AVAILABLE/Select) and is fine.
- However, packet D (FOUNDER_UI_DECISION_PACKET_2026-10-01.md:73-77) claims 'exact action behavior' and cites the product-card-comparison captures. D is therefore not faithful until this is fixed.

Minor items verified:
- The price line is ink at weight 500 (preview.css:706-709). Core uses text-ink-mute for no-price (Core :239).
- mono-label weight is 600 (preview.css:408-414); Core is 500 (index.css:194-199).
- body-xs has no CSS definition in Core.

This matches MemberCatalogExperience.tsx:116-130 (`product.media &&`, aspectRatio 4/3, objectFit contain, border rule) and MemberProductDetailExperience.tsx:167-180 (4:3 contain, otherwise ResearchPendingPanel 'An approved product image is not available.'). section.tsx:381-382 routes those paths.
- Proposed panel: preview.js:286-291 is labelled 'UNAPPROVED · 1:1'.
- Receipt: I re-tabulated all 20 geometry captures (product-detail-comparison and founder-decisions at 10 widths each). public-no-image has 0 images and 0 media. member-4x3 measures 1.3333-1.3334, contain. proposed-1x1 measures 1, contain. Both image panels use GRP-0256, sha e04c2e59.

That label is still not on the E panel, and packet section E (FOUNDER_UI_DECISION_PACKET:97-102) says only 'Signed-in member catalog/detail: source supports an optional 4:3 slot'. - The callout names the exact route.
- The three-way page states that the Full catalog has no media (preview.js:372-373, 379-380), and the packet lists that page as primary evidence (line 16).
